requires.for: short authoritative transactions, revision checks and durable proposal/job state
reference identity where Task context resolves Contacts/Customers/settings
RFC hierarchy, WFM ownership context, SR/Device Reference relationships and terminal cascade inputs
accepted WFM source-plan observations and source-vs-operational-plan conflict proposals

constrained_by.for: canonical UTC instants, effective-vs-recording time, audit/history and transaction semantics

consumed_by.for: reporting/time context only; SLA cannot infer Task execution from Objective plan
reviewed Task physical-consequence inputs; Inventory cannot own Task outcome
Objective/Task workbench commands and regroup/review UI
timeline, operational counts and narrative projections

forbidden_dependencies: Task lifecycle must not depend on Inventory state labels.
Objective grouping must not depend on Customer/RFC partitions as temporal boundaries.
Task plan must not be derived by reading mutable UI state.
Actual execution must not be inferred from WFM provider completion or Objective clock passage.
Objective aggregate outcome must not be independently writable around member Task outcomes.

lld_handoffs.scope: Task/Objective schema, commands, overlap grouping, execution, review, retry and historical proposal algorithms
